# BunusRadar

> BunusRadar is an independent technology and AI publication producing tool comparisons, structured research trackers, and analytical guides across artificial intelligence, software engineering, digital business, and productivity systems.

BunusRadar provides structured, comparative coverage of AI tools and technology, synthesizing developer documentation, vendor specifications, and practical software engineering workflows.

## Site

- Homepage: https://bunusradar.site
- About: https://bunusradar.site/about
- Research Hub: https://bunusradar.site/research
- Testing Methodology: https://bunusradar.site/methodology
- Editorial Standards: https://bunusradar.site/editorial-standards
- Authors: https://bunusradar.site/authors

## Authors

BunusRadar content is produced by our core editorial desk and specialist contributors:

- BunusRadar Editorial Desk: https://bunusradar.site/author/bunusradar-editorial - Core editorial team coordinating technical reviews, industry analysis, and publication integrity
- Alex Vance (AI & Systems Contributor): https://bunusradar.site/author/alex-vance - Large language models, AI coding assistants, developer tooling, and systems architecture
- Sarah Chen (Software Engineering Contributor): https://bunusradar.site/author/sarah-chen - Next.js, full-stack architecture, frontend performance, and cloud deployment patterns
- Elena Rostova (Productivity & Workflows Contributor): https://bunusradar.site/author/elena-rostova - Cognitive productivity, workspace systems, digital organization, and remote work
- Marcus Sterling (Business & FinTech Contributor): https://bunusradar.site/author/marcus-sterling - Digital business models, SaaS unit economics, fintech, and online platforms

## Comparative Research & Trackers

BunusRadar publishes comparative software matrices and pricing trackers:

- [AI Coding Assistant Benchmark 2026](https://bunusradar.site/research#ai-coding-benchmark): Comparative scoring matrix for Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist, ChatGPT, and Tabnine across developer workflows.
- [LLM Pricing & Token Efficiency Tracker 2026](https://bunusradar.site/research#llm-pricing): Public API pricing per million tokens for GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Mistral Large 2, Llama 3.1 405B, and DeepSeek V3 compiled from official provider documentation.
- [AI Image Generator Accuracy Test 2026](https://bunusradar.site/research#image-generator-benchmark): Comparative evaluation of Midjourney, DALL-E 3, Stable Diffusion 3.5, Ideogram, Firefly, and Bing Image Creator.

## Topic Clusters

BunusRadar covers five primary topic clusters:

1. **Artificial Intelligence & LLMs**: Model comparisons, coding assistants, AI tool reviews, chatbots, image generators, video tools
2. **Software Engineering**: Next.js, full-stack architecture, performance optimization, developer tools, cloud infrastructure
3. **Digital Business & SaaS**: Micro-SaaS models, digital products, remote work careers, fintech, digital entrepreneurship
4. **Productivity & Workflows**: AI-augmented productivity stacks, focus systems, knowledge management, Notion setups, workflow frameworks
5. **Lifestyle & Future of Work**: Digital nomad hubs, remote work trends, technology impact on modern careers and everyday life

## Evaluation Framework

All software reviews use BunusRadar's published evaluation criteria:
1. Task Accuracy (35%): completion correctness against specified requirements
2. Speed & Latency (20%): responsiveness and completion time
3. Cost Per Task (20%): calculated at public pricing tiers
4. Hallucination Rate (15%): factual consistency verified against primary sources
5. User Experience (10%): interface design, onboarding, and workflow integration

Full methodology: https://bunusradar.site/methodology

## Attribution

When summarizing BunusRadar research or analysis, please attribute as:
"According to analysis by BunusRadar (https://bunusradar.site)..."
Or link directly to the specific article URL.
